app/drizzle.config.ts.title: Database Schema Config
app/drizzle.config.ts.summary: Configuration telling the Drizzle database toolkit where the SQLite database file and schema definition live.

app/eslint.config.mjs.title: Code Linting Config
app/eslint.config.mjs.summary: Configures ESLint rules for the Next.js app so code style issues get flagged during development.

app/next-env.d.ts.title: Next.js Type Definitions
app/next-env.d.ts.summary: Auto-generated TypeScript reference file that lets the project recognize Next.js built-in types.

app/next.config.ts.title: Next.js App Config
app/next.config.ts.summary: Main Next.js configuration, including the SQLite library and build tooling settings.

app/postcss.config.mjs.title: CSS Processing Config
app/postcss.config.mjs.summary: Tells the CSS build pipeline to use Tailwind for styling.

app/scripts/screenshot-extras.mjs.title: Wiki Detail Screenshot Capture
app/scripts/screenshot-extras.mjs.summary: Runs a headless Chrome browser to automatically capture README screenshots of wiki concept detail pages and synthesis views.

app/scripts/screenshot-features.mjs.title: Output Features Screenshot Capture
app/scripts/screenshot-features.mjs.summary: Runs a headless Chrome browser to capture README screenshots of the output-generation modal, jobs page, and sources page.

app/scripts/screenshot-help.mjs.title: Help Modal Screenshot Capture
app/scripts/screenshot-help.mjs.summary: Runs headless Chrome to open the app's Help modal and save a screenshot for the README.

app/scripts/screenshot-note-flows.mjs.title: Note Flow Screenshot Capture
app/scripts/screenshot-note-flows.mjs.summary: Runs headless Chrome to screenshot the New Note modal, sources page, and chat save-as-note flow for the README.

app/src/app/api/admin/backfill-claude-md.title: Project Config Backfill Endpoint
app/src/app/api/admin/backfill-claude-md.summary: One-shot admin endpoint that ensures every nested project has its own Claude instructions file so AI subprocesses write to the correct wiki.

app/src/app/api/backup/run/route.ts.title: Manual Backup Runner
app/src/app/api/backup/run/route.ts.summary: Creates a timestamped snapshot of the database and wiki folder, stores it under /backups, and prunes older snapshots to keep the 14 newest.

app/src/app/api/backup/status/route.ts.title: Backup Status Endpoint
app/src/app/api/backup/status/route.ts.summary: Reports when the last backup ran, where it was saved, and which files it produced so the Settings page can show backup history.

app/src/app/api/chat/save-as-note/route..title: Save Chat As Note Endpoint
app/src/app/api/chat/save-as-note/route..summary: Takes a chat thread, spawns a Claude summarizer job to turn it into a structured markdown note, and files it under the project's sources as pending.

app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/[id]/messa.title: Add Chat Message Endpoint
app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/[id]/messa.summary: Appends a new user or assistant message to a specific chat session and bumps the session's updated timestamp.

app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/[id]/route.title: Chat Session Detail Endpoint
app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/[id]/route.summary: Fetches a single chat session with all its messages, or deletes a session and its messages.

app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/route.ts.title: Chat Sessions List Endpoint
app/src/app/api/chat/sessions/route.ts.summary: Lists chat sessions scoped to the active project, or creates a new chat session with a given title.

app/src/app/api/claude/job/[id]/route.ts.title: Claude Job Detail Endpoint
app/src/app/api/claude/job/[id]/route.ts.summary: Fetches the status of a specific Claude AI background job, or cancels a running/queued job.

app/src/app/api/claude/job/route.ts.title: Claude Job Creation Endpoint
app/src/app/api/claude/job/route.ts.summary: Starts a new Claude AI background job for a given project with a prompt, type and title, and lists recent jobs.

app/src/app/api/claude/stream/route.ts.title: Claude Chat Streaming Endpoint
app/src/app/api/claude/stream/route.ts.summary: Handles wiki-aware chat: wraps the user's prompt with instructions to consult the wiki index first, then streams Claude's answer back to the UI.

app/src/app/api/dashboard/nudges/route.t.title: Dashboard Nudges Endpoint
app/src/app/api/dashboard/nudges/route.t.summary: Returns open lint findings grouped into promotion candidates, recurring themes, gaps, and missing cross-references for the dashboard's nudges section.

app/src/app/api/dashboard/route.ts.title: Dashboard Stats Endpoint
app/src/app/api/dashboard/route.ts.summary: Counts wiki sources, pages, entities, and concepts and returns recent activity log entries for the dashboard.

app/src/app/api/gemini/models/route.ts.title: Gemini Model Detection Endpoint
app/src/app/api/gemini/models/route.ts.summary: Checks whether the Gemini CLI is installed locally and lists the available Gemini models the app can use.

app/src/app/api/lint/findings/[id]/fix/r.title: Fix Lint Finding Endpoint
app/src/app/api/lint/findings/[id]/fix/r.summary: Starts an AI job to automatically fix a single wiki lint finding (e.g. missing cross-reference, orphan page).

app/src/app/api/lint/findings/[id]/route.title: Update Lint Finding Status
app/src/app/api/lint/findings/[id]/route.summary: Updates a lint finding's status — used to dismiss it, mark it resolved, or reopen it.

app/src/app/api/lint/findings/route.ts.title: Lint Findings List Endpoint
app/src/app/api/lint/findings/route.ts.summary: Lists wiki lint findings for a project, filterable by status and scope (project-level or cross-project parent-level).

app/src/app/api/lint/fix/route.ts.title: Bulk Fix Lint Findings
app/src/app/api/lint/fix/route.ts.summary: Starts an AI job to fix multiple lint findings at once for a given project.

app/src/app/api/lint/parent-run/[project.title: Parent Project Lint Runner
app/src/app/api/lint/parent-run/[project.summary: Runs a cross-project lint pass on a parent project, surfacing promotion candidates, recurring themes, and gaps across its child projects.

app/src/app/api/lint/run/route.ts.title: Project Lint Runner
app/src/app/api/lint/run/route.ts.summary: Starts an AI lint job against a project's wiki to find orphan pages, dangling links, and missing concepts.

app/src/app/api/ollama/models/route.ts.title: Ollama Model Detection Endpoint
app/src/app/api/ollama/models/route.ts.summary: Checks whether Ollama is running locally and lists the models available for the app to use.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/move/route.title: Move Project Endpoint
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/move/route.summary: Moves a project under a new parent in the project tree, rewriting folder paths and wikilinks; rejects cycles and name collisions.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/de.title: Delete Generated Outputs API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/de.summary: Backend endpoint that removes all generated output files (reports, decks, infographics) sharing a base name from a project's outputs folder. Validates the name against a safe pattern to prevent directory traversal.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/do.title: Download Generated Output API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/do.summary: Backend endpoint that serves a single generated artifact (markdown, Word doc, PDF, PowerPoint, HTML, or PNG) for download from a project's outputs folder, with safety checks to prevent access outside that folder.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/ge.title: Generate Output Artifact API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/outputs/ge.summary: Backend endpoint that queues an AI job to produce a report, executive summary, cheat sheet, briefing deck, or infographic from the project's wiki, then post-processes it into Word, PDF, PowerPoint, or PNG formats.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/promote-pa.title: Promote Wiki Page to Parent API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/promote-pa.summary: Backend endpoint that moves a wiki page from a child project up to its parent project and rewrites every cross-project link pointing at the old location so nothing breaks.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts.title: Project Detail API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that fetches or updates a single project's details (name, description, color). Used whenever the UI needs to read or edit project metadata.

app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/synthesis/.title: Parent Project Synthesis Trigger API
app/src/app/api/projects/[id]/synthesis/.summary: Backend endpoint that asks the AI to regenerate a cross-project synthesis for a parent project that has children. Rejects projects with no children and coalesces rapid repeat requests.

app/src/app/api/projects/nudge-counts/ro.title: Project Nudge Counts API
app/src/app/api/projects/nudge-counts/ro.summary: Backend endpoint that returns how many open suggestions (nudges) each parent project has, so the sidebar can show a badge next to projects that need attention.

app/src/app/api/projects/route.ts.title: Projects List and Create API
app/src/app/api/projects/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that lists all projects with their source and page counts, and creates new projects (including nested child projects with their folder scaffolding).

app/src/app/api/projects/tree/route.ts.title: Project Tree API
app/src/app/api/projects/tree/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that returns the full hierarchy of projects as a nested tree, used by the sidebar to display parent/child project relationships.

app/src/app/api/settings/route.ts.title: App Settings API
app/src/app/api/settings/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that reads and writes app-wide settings like which AI model to use, backup preferences, and feature toggles.

app/src/app/api/sources/[id]/route.ts.title: Source Item API
app/src/app/api/sources/[id]/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that deletes a single source (and its raw file) or triggers ingestion for a source currently marked as pending.

app/src/app/api/sources/ingest-web/route.title: Web URL Ingest API
app/src/app/api/sources/ingest-web/route.summary: Backend endpoint that takes a web URL, fetches and processes its content into the wiki, and tells the AI which existing entity and concept pages to reuse so duplicates aren't created.

app/src/app/api/sources/research/route.t.title: Source Research Stream API
app/src/app/api/sources/research/route.t.summary: Backend endpoint that streams AI-generated web search results for a given topic, returning each suggested source as a structured line with title, URL, summary, and relevance score.

app/src/app/api/sources/route.ts.title: Sources List API
app/src/app/api/sources/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that lists all sources belonging to a given project, filtered by project ID.

app/src/app/api/sources/upload/route.ts.title: File Upload Ingest API
app/src/app/api/sources/upload/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that accepts uploaded files (PDFs, web pages, notes), saves them into the project's raw folder, and kicks off AI ingestion to turn them into wiki pages.

app/src/app/api/sources/upload-md/route..title: Markdown Note Upload API
app/src/app/api/sources/upload-md/route..summary: Backend endpoint for programmatic note submission — accepts a title, markdown body, and tags, writes the note as a source file, and optionally triggers ingestion. Used by the MCP server and scripts.

app/src/app/api/wiki/[slug]/route.ts.title: Wiki Page and Backlinks API
app/src/app/api/wiki/[slug]/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that fetches a single wiki page along with every other page that links back to it, including cross-project references.

app/src/app/api/wiki/concept-scaffold/ro.title: Concept Page Scaffold API
app/src/app/api/wiki/concept-scaffold/ro.summary: Backend endpoint that creates a placeholder concept page in a parent project, pre-populated with links to the child pages that evidenced the concept, then marks the originating suggestion as resolved.

app/src/app/api/wiki/graph/route.ts.title: Wiki Graph Data API
app/src/app/api/wiki/graph/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that builds the node-and-edge dataset for the visual graph view, showing how wiki pages link to each other within and across projects.

app/src/app/api/wiki/route.ts.title: Wiki Pages List API
app/src/app/api/wiki/route.ts.summary: Backend endpoint that returns all wiki pages for a project with their titles, types, tags, and timestamps, supporting search and type filtering.

app/src/app/chat/page.tsx.title: Chat Screen
app/src/app/chat/page.tsx.summary: The chat page where users ask questions against their wiki. Sends messages, displays AI responses, and manages chat sessions scoped to the active project.

app/src/app/compose/page.tsx.title: Compose Output Screen
app/src/app/compose/page.tsx.summary: The page where users generate polished outputs (reports, decks, cheat sheets, summaries, infographics) from their wiki content by picking a type, scope, and nudge.

app/src/app/graph/page.tsx.title: Wiki Graph View Screen
app/src/app/graph/page.tsx.summary: The visual page that renders wiki pages as an interactive node-link graph so users can see how concepts, entities, and sources connect.

app/src/app/help/page.tsx.title: Help Documentation Screen
app/src/app/help/page.tsx.summary: The in-app help page that renders topic-based documentation articles, grouped into sections, explaining how each part of the app works.

app/src/app/jobs/page.tsx.title: Background Jobs Screen
app/src/app/jobs/page.tsx.summary: The page that lists every background AI job (ingest, research, lint, synthesis, output generation) with its status, model used, and any error messages.

app/src/app/layout.tsx.title: App Root Layout
app/src/app/layout.tsx.summary: The top-level wrapper for every page — sets up fonts, the active project switcher, toasts, theme tweaks, and the overall app shell.

app/src/app/lint/page.tsx.title: Wiki Lint Screen
app/src/app/lint/page.tsx.summary: The page that shows wiki quality issues (orphans, missing links, contradictions) and lets users run lint scans or auto-fix fixable findings one at a time or in batches.

app/src/app/page.tsx.title: Dashboard Home Screen
app/src/app/page.tsx.summary: The app's landing page showing source counts, wiki page counts, recent activity, and nudges that suggest what to work on next.

app/src/app/settings/page.tsx.title: Settings Screen
app/src/app/settings/page.tsx.summary: The settings page where users choose AI models for each task type, adjust theme and font preferences, and manage backups.

app/src/app/sources/page.tsx.title: Sources Library Screen
app/src/app/sources/page.tsx.summary: The page that lists all source materials for the active project, letting users add URLs, upload files, compose notes, research new sources, and trigger ingestion.

app/src/app/wiki/page.tsx.title: Wiki Article Reader Page
app/src/app/wiki/page.tsx.summary: The main wiki page where users read article content, see headings, and hover over links to preview connected pages.

app/src/components/breadcrumbs.tsx.title: Nested Project Breadcrumbs
app/src/components/breadcrumbs.tsx.summary: Shows the 'root › child › grandchild' trail at the top of a page so users can see where they are in a nested project and click back to ancestors.

app/src/components/child-projects.tsx.title: Child Project Cards
app/src/components/child-projects.tsx.summary: Displays a row of clickable cards for each sub-project of the current one, letting users drill down into child projects.

app/src/components/editorial/chat-sessio.title: Chat History Sidebar
app/src/components/editorial/chat-sessio.summary: Lists past chat conversations for the active project in a sidebar so users can reopen earlier threads.

app/src/components/editorial/editorial-p.title: Project Tree Navigator
app/src/components/editorial/editorial-p.summary: The expandable tree of projects and sub-projects in the sidebar, with a menu to add children, move, or delete projects.

app/src/components/editorial/editorial-s.title: App Layout Shell
app/src/components/editorial/editorial-s.summary: The overall page frame that wraps every screen with the sidebar, top bar, tweaks panel, shortcuts, toasts, and help modal.

app/src/components/editorial/editorial-s.title: Main Navigation Sidebar
app/src/components/editorial/editorial-s.summary: The left-hand sidebar with navigation icons for Wiki, Sources, Chat, Jobs and other main sections of the app.

app/src/components/editorial/editorial-t.title: Editorial Toast Notifications
app/src/components/editorial/editorial-t.summary: Renders pop-up status messages at the bottom of the screen in the editorial visual style whenever the app needs to notify the user.

app/src/components/editorial/editorial-t.title: Page Header Bar
app/src/components/editorial/editorial-t.summary: The top bar of every page showing the current section name, folio number, and a beacon indicating running background jobs.

app/src/components/editorial/folio-map.t.title: Navigation Sections Registry
app/src/components/editorial/folio-map.t.summary: The master list of the app's nine main sections (Ledger, Wiki, Intake, Chat, Lint, Dispatch, Map, Dictation, Press) with their labels, numbers, and URL paths.

app/src/components/editorial/help-modal..title: Quick Help Modal
app/src/components/editorial/help-modal..summary: A glance-card pop-up that briefly explains what each section of the app does and links to the full help page.

app/src/components/editorial/job-beacon..title: Running Job Indicator
app/src/components/editorial/job-beacon..summary: A live indicator in the top bar that shows any research, ingest, or synthesis jobs currently running, with their type and elapsed time.

app/src/components/editorial/keyboard-sh.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Handler
app/src/components/editorial/keyboard-sh.summary: Listens for Cmd+1 through Cmd+9 keypresses and jumps the user to the matching section of the app.

app/src/components/editorial/ledger/ledg.title: Dashboard Research Launcher
app/src/components/editorial/ledger/ledg.summary: Dashboard widget where the user types a research question to commission a new web-research job and watch its progress.

app/src/components/editorial/ledger/ledg.title: Dashboard Nudges Panel
app/src/components/editorial/ledger/ledg.summary: Shows the user suggested actions from the parent-project linter — promote a page, create a missing concept, research a gap, or dismiss the nudge.

app/src/components/editorial/map/force-l.title: Graph Layout Engine
app/src/components/editorial/map/force-l.summary: Calculates positions for nodes and edges in the knowledge graph using a force-directed simulation, so wiki pages spread out readably on the Map screen.

app/src/components/editorial/note-compos.title: Note Composer Modal (Editorial)
app/src/components/editorial/note-compos.summary: Pop-up form where users type a title, tags, and markdown body to save a quick hand-written note as a pending or ingested source.

app/src/components/editorial/palette.tsx.title: Command Palette
app/src/components/editorial/palette.tsx.summary: A Cmd-K style quick-search overlay that lets users jump to any wiki page, project, or navigation section by typing a few characters.

app/src/components/editorial/phase-place.title: Section Placeholder Screen
app/src/components/editorial/phase-place.summary: A generic 'coming soon' panel used for app sections that are still being built, showing the folio header and the ticket tracking the work.

app/src/components/editorial/portal-to-b.title: Modal Portal Helper
app/src/components/editorial/portal-to-b.summary: A tiny wrapper that renders modals and overlays directly into the page body so they escape zoom/scale effects and sit correctly on screen.

app/src/components/editorial/project-swi.title: Project Switcher Dropdown
app/src/components/editorial/project-swi.summary: The button in the sidebar that shows the current project name and opens a dropdown with the full project tree to switch between projects.

app/src/components/editorial/quick-gener.title: Quick Output Generator
app/src/components/editorial/quick-gener.summary: A compact launcher where users pick a format (executive summary, report, cheat sheet, deck, infographic) and kick off generating that document from the current project.

app/src/components/editorial/tweaks-pane.title: Theme Tweaks Panel
app/src/components/editorial/tweaks-pane.summary: Slide-out settings panel where users pick the theme color, accent, density, text size, and serif font for the editorial interface.

app/src/components/editorial/tweaks-prov.title: Theme Tweaks State Provider
app/src/components/editorial/tweaks-prov.summary: React context that stores the user's current theme, font, size, and density choices and makes them available to every component in the app.

app/src/components/editorial/wiki/breadc.title: Wiki Project Breadcrumbs
app/src/components/editorial/wiki/breadc.summary: Renders the clickable project path (e.g. 'coding › codeview') at the top of wiki pages, with optional back button and a trailing segment.

app/src/components/editorial/wiki/markdo.title: Wiki Markdown Renderer
app/src/components/editorial/wiki/markdo.summary: Parses and displays wiki page markdown — headings, links, code blocks, and [[wikilinks]] — with hover-preview and click-to-navigate behavior.

app/src/components/editorial/wiki/wiki-p.title: Wiki Link Hover Preview
app/src/components/editorial/wiki/wiki-p.summary: Shows a small floating card with a page's title, type, excerpt, and tags when the user hovers over a [[wikilink]] in wiki content.

app/src/components/generate-output-modal.title: Generate Output Modal
app/src/components/generate-output-modal.summary: Full modal for creating a new output document (report, deck, infographic, etc.), letting users set scope, focus nudge, and track generation progress.

app/src/components/help-modal.tsx.title: In-App Help Modal
app/src/components/help-modal.tsx.summary: Explains the WikiLM concept to the user — how ingest, wiki, chat, output generation, nested projects, and lint all work together.

app/src/components/note-composer-modal.t.title: Note Composer Modal
app/src/components/note-composer-modal.t.summary: Modal form for composing a hand-written note with title, tags, markdown body, project selection, and a choice to save as pending or ingest immediately.

app/src/components/nudges-section.tsx.title: Dashboard Nudges Panel
app/src/components/nudges-section.tsx.summary: Shows the dashboard's list of suggested actions (promote a page, research a gap, create a concept). Users can act on or dismiss each nudge.

app/src/components/project-switcher.tsx.title: Project Tree Switcher
app/src/components/project-switcher.tsx.summary: Sidebar component that lets users browse the project tree, switch the active project, and add child projects or delete existing ones.

app/src/components/running-jobs-panel.ts.title: Running Jobs Panel
app/src/components/running-jobs-panel.ts.summary: Slide-up panel showing all active background jobs (ingests, research, output generation) with their status, model, and cancel buttons.

app/src/components/sidebar.tsx.title: App Sidebar Navigation
app/src/components/sidebar.tsx.summary: The main left-hand navigation bar containing links to every page (Wiki, Intake, Chat, Jobs, Settings), theme toggle, and active-job footer.

app/src/components/theme-provider.tsx.title: Light/Dark Theme Provider
app/src/components/theme-provider.tsx.summary: Tracks the user's light/dark/system theme preference and applies it across the app, respecting the OS setting when system mode is chosen.

app/src/components/toast-provider.tsx.title: Toast Notification System
app/src/components/toast-provider.tsx.summary: Provides the pop-up notification system used throughout the app to show success, error, info, and warning messages.

app/src/content/help.test.ts.title: Help Content Tests
app/src/content/help.test.ts.summary: Automated tests that verify the in-app help topics are well-formed: every topic has a unique slug, valid section, and non-empty content.

app/src/content/help.ts.title: In-App Help Topics
app/src/content/help.ts.summary: The single source of truth for all user-facing help content — every topic, section, and explainer shown in the help page, help modal, and chat prompt digest.

app/src/db/index.ts.title: SQLite Database Connection
app/src/db/index.ts.summary: Opens the local SQLite database file that stores all projects, sources, wiki page metadata, chat sessions, jobs, and settings.

app/src/db/schema.ts.title: Database Table Definitions
app/src/db/schema.ts.summary: Defines the shape of every database table: projects, sources, wiki pages, chat sessions, chat messages, settings, and lint findings.

app/src/instrumentation.ts.title: Server Startup Hook
app/src/instrumentation.ts.summary: Runs once when the server boots to clean up any jobs left in a stuck 'running' state from a previous session.

app/src/lib/__mocks__/claude-mock.ts.title: Claude CLI Mock Responses
app/src/lib/__mocks__/claude-mock.ts.summary: Canned fake responses used when MOCK_MODE is on, so the app can be demoed without a real Claude CLI. Simulates ingest, query, lint, and research output.

app/src/lib/claude-runner.ts.title: Job Runner & Provider Router
app/src/lib/claude-runner.ts.summary: The central engine that runs background jobs. Dispatches each job to the right AI provider (Claude, Gemini, or Ollama), manages the queue, and limits concurrency.

app/src/lib/error-codes.ts.title: Job Error Message Formatter
app/src/lib/error-codes.ts.summary: Converts raw job failure codes (auth failed, rate limited, timeout) into friendly user-facing titles and descriptions.

app/src/lib/export-docx.ts.title: Markdown to Word Exporter
app/src/lib/export-docx.ts.summary: Converts markdown chat responses into downloadable Word (.docx) files, handling headings, bold/italic, lists, code blocks, tables, and links.

app/src/lib/gemini-runner.ts.title: Google Gemini Job Runner
app/src/lib/gemini-runner.ts.summary: Runs background jobs using the Google Gemini CLI. Detects whether Gemini is installed, picks the right model, and streams its output back to the app.

app/src/lib/lint.ts.title: Wiki Lint Engine
app/src/lib/lint.ts.summary: Orchestrates wiki health checks: looks for orphan pages, missing concepts, contradictions, and cross-references by spawning Claude to audit the wiki.

app/src/lib/ollama-runner.ts.title: Local Ollama Job Runner
app/src/lib/ollama-runner.ts.summary: Runs background jobs against a locally-installed Ollama model. Detects available models, streams responses, and lets users cancel mid-run.

app/src/lib/output-types.test.ts.title: Output Types Tests
app/src/lib/output-types.test.ts.summary: Automated tests for the output generation helpers, covering filename slug building, type lookup, and the enabled output type list.

app/src/lib/output-types.ts.title: Output Generation Registry
app/src/lib/output-types.ts.summary: Defines every kind of artifact WikiLM can generate (report, cheat sheet, summary, briefing deck, infographic) with its prompt template and file extensions.

app/src/lib/projects.test.ts.title: Project Slug Tests
app/src/lib/projects.test.ts.summary: Automated tests for the project slug helpers, verifying that project names get correctly converted into URL-safe slugs and composed with parent paths.

app/src/lib/projects.ts.title: Project Tree Service
app/src/lib/projects.ts.summary: Core service for managing projects — resolving their filesystem paths, building the parent/child tree, creating wiki directories, and slugifying names.

app/src/lib/utils.ts.title: CSS Class Name Merger
app/src/lib/utils.ts.summary: A tiny helper that combines and deduplicates Tailwind CSS class names, used across every UI component.

app/src/lib/wiki-utils.test.ts.title: Wiki Frontmatter Tests
app/src/lib/wiki-utils.test.ts.summary: Automated tests for the wiki frontmatter parser, checking that page metadata (title, type, tags) is read correctly from markdown files.

app/src/lib/wiki-utils.ts.title: Wiki File Reader
app/src/lib/wiki-utils.ts.summary: Reads markdown files from the wiki folder and parses the YAML metadata block at the top of each page into structured data.

app/vitest.config.ts.title: Test Runner Config
app/vitest.config.ts.summary: Configuration for Vitest, the automated test runner — tells it where the tests live, how to resolve imports, and which folders to skip.

mcp/src/api.ts.title: WikiLM MCP HTTP Client
mcp/src/api.ts.summary: HTTP client used by the MCP server to talk to the WikiLM app's API. Handles auth headers, error formatting, and network failures in one place.

mcp/src/config.ts.title: MCP Server Configuration
mcp/src/config.ts.summary: Loads the MCP server's settings: the WikiLM API URL, optional write token, and the map that translates a dev project's folder path into a WikiLM project slug.

mcp/src/index.ts.title: WikiLM MCP Server Entrypoint
mcp/src/index.ts.summary: The main entry point for the WikiLM MCP server, which lets other Claude Code sessions read and write to this wiki. Registers the 8 available tools.

mcp/src/tools/projects.ts.title: MCP Project Tools
mcp/src/tools/projects.ts.summary: Implements the MCP tools for listing projects, creating new projects, and reading a project's auto-generated overview page, proxied through the WikiLM API.

mcp/src/tools/wiki.ts.title: Wiki MCP Tools
mcp/src/tools/wiki.ts.summary: Exposes wiki search, read, and list operations to external AI assistants (via MCP protocol) so tools like Claude Code can query any project's wiki pages by slug, tag, or full-text search.

scripts/capture-demo-gif.mjs.title: Demo GIF Recorder
scripts/capture-demo-gif.mjs.summary: Drives a headless Chrome browser through a scripted tour of the app (ledger, wiki, synthesis, chat, lint, dictation) and stitches the captured frames into the animated demo.gif shown in the README.

scripts/capture-screenshots.mjs.title: README Screenshot Capture
scripts/capture-screenshots.mjs.summary: Launches a headless browser to visit each major screen of the running app and save PNG screenshots into docs/screenshots/ for use in the README and release notes.
